context: A lane that runs on Opus (reviewers, the third build round) is blocked when your typed grant, such as `opus reviewers 2h`, was typed in another session. The guard in the lane cannot see it. This item is from the coordinator, who raised it at 13:43 CDT Oct 29.

options.gain: You type a grant once, anywhere; lanes pick it up; each grant has your words and time on record.
options.how: When you grant Opus, the triage session writes your words and the time on the roadmap step. The guard in a lane reads that step. The coordinator also scans for lanes blocked on a grant.
options.label: Record grants on the roadmap step; the lane's guard reads them
options.lose: A new guard read and a coordinator scan to build; a grant is slower to reach a lane than a typed line.

options.gain: Nothing new to build; the grant is always yours, typed.
options.how: No change to the guard; you type the grant in every lane that needs it.
options.label: You type `opus reviewers 2h` into each lane
options.lose: You type it in every blocked lane, and each lane waits until you do.

options.how: A brief says you granted Opus; the guard lets it through.
options.label: The guard accepts a grant that a brief claims
options.lose: Goes against uniform ruling t18: a brief could claim a grant you never gave.

ref: c201 (session tiers); uniform ruling t18 (the guard accepts only what you typed)
title: How does your Opus grant reach a lane that needs it?
why: It keeps the grant yours and on record, without you typing into every lane (the coordinator's recommendation).
